title: Carnillean Rising
start: Speak with Xenia outside of the Carnillean mansion in south-west East Ardougne.

items.t: 23 free inventory spaces to collect items during the quest

kills.t: None, but the players will need to dodge attacks from a Cave Wolf Matriarch (level 91)

rewards.t: 2x 1500 Skill XP lamps for a total of 3000 Skill XP (Skill must be level 30 or higher)
5000 coins coins for returning Lady Henryeta's necklace, or from opening Sir Ceril's money pouch
100 oak planks (worth NoCoins | GE price | c )
30 teak planks (worth NoCoins | GE price | c )
10 mahogany planks (worth NoCoins | GE price | c )
A treasure chest, containing a gold bar (the treasure chest itself can be used to create personal treasure hunts)

steps.t: Outside the Carnillean Mansion south-west of East Ardougne, talk to Xenia. [Chat: 2 Yes, I remember you. › 1 Thanks for fixing it! › Accept]
Talk to Ceril Carnillean. [Chat: 1 So, you want me to turn Philipe into an adventurer. › 1 How do you expect me to create a quest? › 1 Where can I find all that stuff? › 4 I'll come back later.]
Search the bookcase in the room with Henryeta Carnillean for a book about the Carnillean family.
Talk to Butler Crichton. [Chat: 1 Sir Ceril says you'll help me create a quest. › 1 Yes, let's go.]
Head into the basement and enter the hole on the east wall (cutscene will begin), then head back to the house.
Go to the floor 2 and take the red and black dragon head from the wall (2 heads in total).
Open and search the southern wardrobe for the armour and sword.
Tear the net curtain from the north-east wall.
Take the money pouch from the bed or Henryeta's necklace from the dresser.
Search his painting set for red paint.

Talk to Sarsaparilla. [Chat: 3 I'm creating a quest for Philipe. Will you help?], then talk again. [Chat: 3 Are you just going to stay in here? › 2 You were talking about your ambitions. › 2 I'm directing a drama. Would you like a part? › 4 Damsel in distress › 1 Yes, follow me.]
Open and search the wardrobe for her dress. [Chat: 1 I need to borrow a costume.]
Head to the cellar and talk to Claus the chef. [Chat: 2 Drunken jailer]
Search the cupboard, take everything (wooden boards, twine, shears, and Sir Ceril's wine).
Search the barrel of junk to collect rusty spikes.
Pick up the spider from the floor.
(optional) Pick up 7 buckets of water from the floor.

sub.t: It is faster to skip this step and build a spike pit instead.

steps.t: Right-click build on the hole hotspot. (The cave going into the next area) [Chat: 1 Cobweb]
Enter the cave and talk to Sarsaparilla [Chat: 1 Yes, follow me.] and Claus. [Chat: 1 Follow me.]
Continue through the cave and talk to the goblins. [Chat: 3 Can you help me? › 3 Here, you can have this armour. › 1 Patrolling guards]
Head to the south-easternmost part of the tunnels and enter the passage.
Search the spoils near the heap for bone scraps south-west of the room.
Take the cave mouse to have the wolves follow you out.
Head north to the centre bridge.
"Build" the "jailer" hotspot by leading Claus to it.

sub.t: Use the money pouch on Claus, if he has not taken it already.

steps.t: Cross the bridge and build the dragon hotspots. The wolves will move into position.
Use the dragon heads on the wolves.
Build the Damsel hotspot.

sub.t: Use the necklace on Sarsaparilla, if she has not taken it already.

steps.t: Head back south across the bridge.
Build hotspots in these locations as you backtrack up towards the cellar:

sub.t: Decoration - on the wall east of the fire [Chat: 1 Bloodstains]
Traps - east and west of the fire [Chat: 1 Tripwire]
Decoration - west of the fire at the end of the hall [Chat: 2 Scary eyes]
Decoration - on the north wall before turning around towards the cave entrance [Chat: 3 Impaled skulls]
Obstacle - on the floor in the southernmost corridor, heading towards the cave entrance [Chat: 2 Spike pit]

p: Luring the little cubs to their doom
Disguising as a humble maid and getting the jailer drunk

steps.t: Head back into the house and talk to Philipe. [Chat: Accept]
Pickpocket him. Talk to him again. [Chat: 4 A bag of sweets. › Accept › 1 Okay, follow me.]
Proceed through the cave while Philipe follows. [Chat: Any]
Watch the cutscene where Philipe attempts to pass the guards.
Talk to Slimepits (one of the goblins) until a dialogue window with the Butler appears - do not continue dialogue until Philipe passes.
Talk to Philipe again to have him follow.
Continue towards Claus. [Chat: Any]
Talk to Philipe again to have him follow.
Continue towards the dragons and talk to Philipe. [Chat: Any]
After the dragons are slain, a cave wolf matriarch will arrive.

Attempt to attack the matriarch to focus its attacks on you. Dodge or withstand the attacks until Philipe kills it. If you run in circles around the matriarch, most of her attacks will miss and you will take very little damage.

sub.t: Do not use Protect from Magic or the matriarch will revert her attention back to Philipe.

steps.t: Talk to Philipe for a cutscene. [Chat: 1 Yes, let's go now!]
Talk to Ceril.
Talk to Xenia. [Chat: 4 So what happens now?]
Talk to Ceril.
Quest complete!
Loot the chest near Ceril.
